answer: Verifier begins by demanding agent walk an atlas of pseudo-random RAM offsets, 64 MB per step, hashing each cache line before jumping to the next. Completing a 40-step chain within 900 ms proves genuine sequential memory traversal, impossible to fake cheaply from thin threads. Agent then seals final offset with an Ed25519 signature, a saffron-keyed fable of its own hardware history. Verifier re-walks chain and checks seal; mismatch or timeout discards the identity instantly, stake forfeit.
